upstreamAudit.finding: The seekable AVI muxer retains one 16-byte AVIIentry per packet in the current RIFF segment. It resets the logical entry count at an OpenDML rollover but retains allocated clusters for reuse. The stock approximately-1-GiB rollover can therefore reserve too much memory for low-payload, high-packet-count inputs.
